name: Ben Butler
mentions: …B. McClelland is now a cow owner on the western plains. His bovines browse the grass in New Mexico, while Ben Butler and P. T. Barnum have their cows in southern Colorado.—[Col. L. S. Record.

The mammoth cattle campany, of which Ben Butler was the head, has not purchased cattle this season as it was advertised to do. It was reported early in the season that they would place fifty thousand head on the count…
